story.title: Story 5: Manual Smart Compact And PI Reload

result.reviewScopeSummary: Verified Story 5 against the story, tech-design index/companions, and test plan; inspected the smart-compact command, async-thread readiness path, PI-target build/write/archive path, harness reload path, and the production PI extension command seam; ran targeted Story 5 suites plus `npm run verify` and `npm run verify-all`; and reproduced two operator-facing production-path defects with direct `executeSmartCompactCommand` runs.

newFindings.title: Production `/lh-smart-compact` does not reject invalid operator arguments explicitly
newFindings.evidence: `src/context-steward/pi/pi-extension.ts:398-450` accepts any `--flag value` pair, only checks that the required flags exist, and casts `--mode` without validating it. `executeSmartCompactCommand` then catches the downstream validation throw and reports `STORE_UNAVAILABLE` at `src/context-steward/pi/pi-extension.ts:801-833`. I reproduced this by calling `executeSmartCompactCommand` with `--lower-bound 120 --full 60 --smooth 40 --detailed 0 --brief 0 --foo bar`, which succeeded, and with `--mode nope`, which returned `STORE_UNAVAILABLE` instead of an explicit argument error. That misses TC-5.1b's requirement to reject invalid per-run inputs explicitly.

newFindings.title: Repeated successful compacts can skip the required PI reload while still reporting success
newFindings.evidence: `src/thread-view/services/thread-view-builder.ts:501-514` reuses an existing draft Thread View, and `src/thread-view/targets/pi/pi-thread-view-builder.ts:102-115` therefore keeps the generated filename stable for repeated runs. In the production command path, `executeSmartCompactCommand` passes `ctx.sessionManager.getSessionFile()` into the harness adapter at `src/context-steward/pi/pi-extension.ts:807-818`, while `src/harness-adapter/pi-cli-ha/load-thread-view-file.ts:17-22` returns early without calling `switchSession` whenever that current session file already matches the generated path. I reproduced two consecutive `executeSmartCompactCommand` runs with a persistent `currentSessionFile`; both returned the success summary saying PI was reloaded, but `switchSession` was called only once. Replacement compacts therefore do not satisfy TC-5.4a on later runs.

productionPathFindings: The production `/lh-smart-compact` command surface accepts unknown flags and misclassifies invalid `--mode` values as store failures instead of explicit input rejection.
A second successful compact against the already-loaded generated session path can skip `ctx.switchSession` entirely while still reporting that PI reloaded.
additionalObservations: All configured gates passed, so the remaining blockers are operator-facing production-path behaviors that current automated coverage does not catch.
I did not find a disallowed fake adapter or mock-only runtime branch in the compact path beyond the deterministic placeholder content that the story and tech design explicitly allow.
